description: This file implements the PackageManager class for handling package download, installation, uninstallation, and management within a plugin framework. It manages download threads, notifications, storage, and package states, and interacts with external components like HttpClient and StorageManager.

classes.name: PackageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing package management functionalities including download, install, uninstall, and notification handling.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a download notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a download notification callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the package manager with a service, sets up storage, and starts download thread.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the package manager, releasing resources.

methods.name: createStorageManagerObject
methods.description: Creates the storage manager object via the current service.

methods.name: releaseStorageManagerObject
methods.description: Releases the storage manager object.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Starts a download for a given URL with options.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses an ongoing download by ID.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused download by ID.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download by ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a downloaded file by its locator.

methods.name: Progress
methods.description: Gets the download progress for a given ID.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage quota and used space details.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets a rate limit for an ongoing download.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Installs a package from a file locator, managing storage and package state.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package by ID.

methods.name: ListPackages
methods.description: Lists all installed packages.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Retrieves runtime configuration for a package.

methods.name: PackageState
methods.description: Gets the installation state of a package.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an installation notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an installation notification callback.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package for exclusive access, returning lock ID and metadata.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a previously locked package.

methods.name: GetLockedInfo
methods.description: Retrieves lock info, including unpacked path and runtime config.

methods.name: InitializeState
methods.description: Initializes package states, possibly from persistent storage.

methods.name: downloader
methods.description: Background thread function handling package downloads with retries and notifications.

methods.name: NotifyDownloadStatus
methods.description: Notifies registered callbacks about download status updates.

methods.name: NotifyInstallStatus
methods.description: Notifies registered callbacks about package installation status.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next download info from the queue.
